deepseek-flash.note: DO NOT USE -- bills the official api.deepseek.com directly. Kept only so arm 1 stays reproducible; use ds-flash-plan / ds-pro-plan instead. RETIRED 2026-08-31 on cost grounds. Used for the first Terminal-Bench arm (1560 trials); kept so that arm stays reproducible. primary model; reasoning disabled

deepseek-pro.note: DO NOT USE -- bills the official api.deepseek.com directly. Kept only so arm 1 stays reproducible; use ds-flash-plan / ds-pro-plan instead. RETIRED 2026-08-31 on cost grounds. Used for the first Terminal-Bench arm (1560 trials); kept so that arm stays reproducible. same vendor, stronger tier

gpt-5.6-low.note: different vendor; endpoint rejects temperature and top_p, so neither is sent. The -none and -medium reasoning tiers of the same endpoint refused the text protocol outright (halting on turn 1 with 'unable to proceed') and were not used; recorded here because it is a model-side confound, not a substrate effect.

deepseek-flash-think.note: DO NOT USE -- bills the official api.deepseek.com directly. Kept only so arm 1 stays reproducible; use ds-flash-plan / ds-pro-plan instead. RETIRED 2026-08-31 on cost grounds. Used for the first Terminal-Bench arm (1560 trials); kept so that arm stays reproducible. same model with reasoning left at the provider default. The other deepseek entries disable it, which is inherited from the repository's .env and is a configuration choice, not a property of the model.

grok-low.note: primary. Reasoning is on and not configurable from here. The relay needs no API key, so container runs carry no credential. Inside a container set ALM_MODEL_URL to the host.docker.internal form.

grok-high.note: same model family at a higher reasoning effort; this is the model factor for H3, replacing the deepseek flash/pro pair.

qwen-max.note: cross-vendor model factor for H3. Paid endpoint: the key lives in .env (gitignored) and is never written into this file.

ds-flash-plan.note: deepseek through the prepaid plan. NOTE: this is the 0731 snapshot, not necessarily byte-identical to the endpoint arm 1 used, so it does not silently extend arm 1.

ds-pro-plan.note: pinned snapshot. Not listed by the endpoint's /models but served: the unpinned 'deepseek-v4-pro' alias can move under you, a dated one cannot, which is what a reproducible arm needs.
